resources.title: Bible Study Lesson 1
resources.description: Watch the lesson and follow along with notes on the Bible's major sections and the historical, cultural, and social setting of a passage.

resources.title: How the Bible Is Organized
resources.description: Find your way through the Bible's major divisions, from the Pentateuch and wisdom literature to the Gospels, letters, and Revelation. Includes a complete book map.

resources.title: Biblical Criticism: A Quick Reference
resources.description: A light overview of the methods used to study Scripture, including textual, historical, and redaction criticism, with practical questions about the speaker, audience, and culture.

resources.title: Bible Study Lesson 2: Order, Image, and Rest
resources.description: Watch Lesson 2 on creation, the image of God, and rest, and follow along with notes on the Bible's major sections and the book of Genesis.

resources.title: Bible Study Lesson 3: Order, Image, Rest part 2
resources.description: Continue the Genesis study on creation, the image of God, responsibility, and rest, with application questions on how we treat one another and how God addresses corruption.
